Ruling: batch #211 item 4 · letter D · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-22T03:49Z

Director seat, summon #26 (`session_01SPwf6Kmqo1gqzCSWSuMtQM`). This seat first recommended B (narrow the commandment and add a narrow gate); the maintainer refused it in terms — verbatim 「我强调了淡化门禁,尤其这个完全没有业务价值,你为什么又要加,你的决裁依据是不是要更新」 — the seat re-recommended D and the maintainer approved 「同意」.

**Governing text:** the maintainer's standing words, 2026-09-21 「我们系统开发了太多无用的门禁,反而在浪费时间」 (ruling #202, objectstack#12708 5753591106) and today's sentence above; the four-axis framework ④ (更少零件); objectui `AGENTS.md` #-1 stays as written.

**Ruled (D): no gate, no census, no text change; the card closes.** `AGENTS.md` commandment #-1 is an instruction whose reader is the agent that reads `AGENTS.md`, like every other line of that file; 「declared ≠ enforced」 is a rule about spec and metadata contracts and runtime capabilities, ⛔ not a licence to build a gate behind every convention. The one shipped defect (#10043's Chinese `title`) is fixed; the 205-file census is an upper bound of translation tables, demos and deliberate test assertions, not a defect count. ⛔ A (sort 205 files by hand) and ⛔ B (narrow + gate) refused: effort on a surface with no measured business pull. ⛔ C (delete the commandment) refused: the convention is real for an international OSS project and costs nothing to keep as an instruction.

**Basis update, filed as the maintainer asked:** objectstack#19647 (`domain:skills`, `pm:queue`, Tier H) carries two sentences into every synced copy of the four-axis framework — ① under ④: new gates default to NO; a gate is a part, and parts are removed, not added, unless the maintainer names the gate; ② 「声明即强制」 applies to spec / metadata contracts and runtime capabilities, ⛔ not to `AGENTS.md`-class conventions whose reader is the agent.

**State in this stroke:** closed `not_planned`; `needs-user-decision` removed; `domain:skills` stays as attribution.
